d:
Sonia Gandhi meets Lalu Yadav kangres ki purv rashtriy adhyaksh soniya gandhi ne aarjedi suprim lalu prasad yadav se mulakat ki hai. soniya gandhi somvar subah ko lalu prasad yadav ke aavas par pahunchin. yahan unhonne lalu prasad yadav se mulakat kar unke svasthy ka hal jana. soniya gandhi ke sath mulakat ke dauran parivar ke sadasy bhi maujud rahe. tejasvi yadav (Tejashwi Yadav) ne kaha ki lalu aur soniya gandhi ke sanbandh hamesha achchhe rahe hain aur donon ne bure vakt men ek-dusre ka sath diya hai.
